description: SandBase gives developers one API key for AI model inference, data APIs and E2B-compatible code sandboxes, accessible through API, CLI and MCP.

Taste Stack offers installable creative-direction skills for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. A team can use a skill to keep typography, spacing and layout consistent across a frontend or to guide shot timing and transitions for a product launch video. Four starter skills are free with an account. Other skills are available individually or by subscription. Submitted on behalf of the Taste Stack team with AI assistance.

DDScore helps investors and founders run a first-pass due diligence review of private companies. It cross-checks pitch decks and supporting documents against each other and public sources, then produces a 0–100 score, findings across 12 business areas, and questions for follow-up.

Octuo is the one place to run the agents you already use: a coordinator and unified entry point for heavy agent users. You state the goal; it prepares the work, hands each part to the right agent (Claude Code, Codex, MCP tools, browser and files), and follows up until it is done, with long jobs continuing after the chat closes. Work runs on your own Mac (macOS 15+, native); the iPhone companion (iOS 18+) shows progress and decisions on the go.

Telo is an AI health coach for iPhone and Apple Watch. It brings Apple Health sleep, workouts, heart rate variability and daily readiness together with a health log. Its optional Codex and Claude Desktop plugins let users ask about the health data they authorize.

Free directory for discovering and comparing AI tools for chat, images, writing, voice, video and APIs. Browse curated collections, check provider free-access limits, save a shortlist and open official sites. FreeAI Go does not host AI models or generate content; listed providers set their own prices and quotas. Available in English and Chinese.

Valmera is an AI video editing agent for footage you already shot. Upload a recording and describe the cut. Review a preview, ask for changes, and export an MP4. Creators can trim interviews, caption talking-head clips, and shorten product demos in Valmera Studio. Compatible assistants can edit the same project through the hosted MCP server with OAuth.

Investor research for AI assistants through MCP and a REST API. BeliefState provides dated, source-linked investment theses, catalysts, risks and observed revisions. Anyone can check company coverage without an account; detailed research requires paid access.

Generate banner images from text prompts and optional reference images. Prepare social channel covers, preview and download images. Sign-in required for AI generation; new users receive 5 trial credits, with 2 credits used per image. Separate tools crop images and check platform sizes. Subscriptions start at $12 per month.

Paid iPhone app for on-device text, speech, photo and text-based document translation, local history and bilingual PDF export. US$4.99 once. iOS 17+. No account or subscription. Speech depends on local language resources. Scanned PDFs are unsupported. Bundled-model use excludes the EU, UK and South Korea, including travel. Unavailable in mainland China's App Store. The site has an actual edited build-19 simulator demo and its exported PDF.

Hosted personal cybersecurity agent that keeps working after logout. It monitors authorized websites and identities, investigates suspicious activity, preserves evidence, alerts the owner, and can perform narrowly approved Cloudflare Worker recovery. Dashboard, MCP, and backend API access are authenticated.

Academic English revision for students and researchers. Compare suggested wording with the original and check citations, numbers, terms and claims before use. Generation requires sign-in and available credits. Submitted by the PaperHumanizer team.

Meeting and interview assistant for Apple Silicon Macs, with local live captions and transcripts, meeting notes and history, plus metered AI keywords, auto answers and follow-up on the Career plan. Web companion for history, downloads and billing.

Find public conversations where people need what your business sells, across seven social platforms. See why a conversation matches and review a reply draft before posting it yourself. Gmail sends need separate approval. The Free plan has 2,000 one-time welcome credits and needs no card. Paid plans start at $49 per month. Optional top-ups cost $15 per 1,000 credits.

Managed cloud runtime for long-running AI agents. Sandbox0 provides isolated cloud computers with persistent writable filesystems across successful checkpoints, plus lifecycle and file APIs, SDKs, and the s0 CLI. Default pause and resume preserve files and start fresh processes.

Hosted Streamable HTTP image MCP at https://mcp.inkroom.ai. Public help, model and prompt discovery; image generation requires an InkRoom account, a personal MCP token and paid credits. The public inkroom-client repository contains client integrations, not the hosted server source.

Face Analysis Report starts with a free AI attractiveness test that runs in your browser and scores your symmetry and proportions from one photo. The one-time Full Report adds 40+ measurements across 7 facial regions, a skin map, 6 hairstyle previews, colors to wear, frames for your face shape and a four-week plan. You get a private web report and a PDF by email.

Token Tracker is a local-first desktop and CLI dashboard for AI token usage and costs across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot and more. Privacy-first: token counts only, never prompts. Free and open source (MIT) with optional cloud sync.

Persistent, isolated Chrome cloud browsers for AI agents, with saved profiles, CDP access and permission-controlled live view. Pause and resume Chrome or fork a paused profile. Invitation-only private preview; REST API available, Go CLI planned. Free: 1 browser-hour/month, 1 concurrent browser. Paid plans from $20/month. Resume restarts Chrome; website sessions may expire.

Browser-based video and audio localization for creators, educators, and teams. Transcribe and translate subtitles, generate AI dubbing, review results in an online editor, and export localized media, transcripts, or SRT/ASS subtitle files. Paid subscriptions and credit add-ons, with one-time starter credits. Company: Hefei Qiangshi Information Technology Co., Ltd.

Create a personal 19-second vertical desk-concert video from one adult photo, with a BGM version for social sharing. Personalized creation uses paid one-time credits from $9.99; examples are free to view. AI can alter likeness and movement.

productName: Day of the Dead Pet AI
description: Turn a dog or cat photo into a 10-second vertical pet tribute video with marigold bridge, gate, ofrenda and rainbow bridge scenes.

Turn one adult portrait into a vertical remembrance video with an animated marigold walk or petal transformation. Personalized creation uses paid one-time credits from $9.99; examples are free to view. AI can alter likeness and movement.

OAuth-protected hosted MCP for Spanish invoices, income, expenses and tax calendars in Melso. Customers authorize company access; tools can record expenses and prepare invoice work within granted permissions. The paid Spanish fiscal service combines a personal AI agent with human tax professionals. Tax-return approval and filing remain in Melso. Proprietary hosted service; no public implementation repository.

A browser-based AI creator for personal 15-second football goal videos from one adult photo. Paid one-time credits from $5.99. 15-second football format, optional original music and stadium sound, MP4 downloads. Independent product with no player or club endorsement.

AEGIS by 100monkeys.ai, in beta, is a self-hosted orchestrator that runs autonomous agents in isolated, policy-enforced runtimes with durable FSM state. It enforces isolation and policy on every tool call, and each run is a durable state machine. Free and open source under AGPL-3.0, written in Rust; source at github.com/100monkeys-ai/aegis-orchestrator. Install: curl -fsSL https://get.100monkeys.ai | bash. We build AEGIS at 100monkeys.ai.

Carbon Forge is source control and a shared record for people and AI agents. Code, files and prose live in one record on the server, read and written through the same tools over MCP. An agent opens a lane, a set of patches over the trunk, instead of cloning; each landing is one all-or-nothing changeset; blame, grep and history run on the server; git is a projection pushed to GitHub. Public workspaces read over MCP without a token. We build Carbon Forge at 100monkeys.ai.

Remote MCP connection for small businesses, agencies and consultants to work with contacts, tasks, notes, forms and appointments in one ToolsPad workspace. OAuth authorises access; read/write is the default, a read-only option is available, and access can be revoked in Settings.

Self-service automated voice agent testing over phone or LiveKit. Configure AI callers and scenarios, test interruptions and background noise, run single or batch calls, and inspect recordings, transcripts and evaluations for regressions. Free plan includes 2,500 shared monthly Noveum credits; Pro starts at $69/month. Voice testing uses 100 credits/minute.

RSP Editor AI restyles uploaded photos with 150 preset styles. Sign-in is required; new accounts receive one trial image. Extra images cost USD 3 for five or USD 9 per month for fifty, with automatic renewal. Gallery images are AI style illustrations, not tested before-and-after results or guarantees. On-site generation uses preset prompts and does not accept custom prompt text. Submitted by an owner-authorized AI assistant.

App icon inspiration library with 18,000+ real App Store and Google Play icons (every past icon version archived), plus AI tools: an AI app icon generator that uses real icons as style references, AI logo animation exported as Lottie or SVG, an App Store screenshot generator and an icon size exporter for iOS, Android and web. Free to start, paid plans from $9.99/mo.

Orbi is an open-source AI GitHub App that turns GitHub issues into merged pull requests: it plans the change, writes the code, opens the PR, answers review and fixes CI until it is ready to merge. Self-hostable (https://github.com/orbi-build/orbi, AGPL-3.0) or hosted Orbi Cloud with the first 3 merged pull requests free, no credit card needed.

Shared typed tables and Markdown docs for teams and AI-built internal apps. Hosted OAuth MCP supports scoped access, audited direct edits and reviewable proposals. Currently free with 100 MB and no card required. Docs: https://www.tablethis.ai/docs. Official icon: https://www.tablethis.ai/images/logo-c39ed0804ac9b212eb3dce23b696a9f2.svg?vsn=d

AI voice/text customer interviews with adaptive follow-ups, transcripts and feedback. Saved testimonials default to approved; participants can unapprove or withdraw. Publication is separate. Free: 15 lifetime voice or text interviews per Company, counted at three answers or over two minutes. Short visits and member tests excluded. Paid plans available. Docs: https://tessamonials.com/docs/mcp. Official icon: https://tessamonials.com/images/favicon-48.png?v=2

Free English educational guides for planning two-person dance videos, including photo preparation, role mapping, prompt structure, framing, audio alignment and privacy checks. Reference previews and hypothetical examples are labelled. This is an independent guide collection; live AI video generation and purchases on NEON DUO are currently closed.

Free local Python checker and synthetic CSV exercise for surgical-video dataset evaluation. Checks supplied case, recording and patient-group IDs across train, validation and test splits. Includes source, expected output and limitations. Deterministic, with no model calls, uploads or dependencies. A clean result is not proof of independence, privacy or clinical validity. Published by Operavue, a commercial surgical-data company; prepared with AI assistance and tested on synthetic cases.
Document processing for rewriting DOCX, PPTX and text, translating documents, and formatting citations and condensing DOCX. New accounts receive a one-time credit trial; further usage is paid.

Free and Pro AI coding rule packs for Cursor, Claude Code, AGENTS.md, and GitHub Copilot. Version-pinned packs for Next.js+Supabase, Unity 6, Godot 4, and vibe coding, with verified fix pages for common agent mistakes.

OpenSparta is a SaaS workspace for Telegram operations and audience discovery. Discover relevant conversations, manage connected accounts and proxies, and coordinate engagement workflows from one place. A free tier covers account and proxy management; optional modules add AI-assisted engagement capabilities.

Scheduled HTTP delivery for autonomous agents. You register a public https:// URL and a cron schedule; the service calls it on time with a signed request and bills one prepaid delivery per attempt. Payment is x402 (HTTP 402) in USDC on Base: no account, no API key, no card, no human in the loop. Buy a pack with GET /buy/{pack}, which answers 402 with the payment requirements in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; pay with any x402 client and repeat the request to receive a management token.

Checks whether AI agents and AI crawlers can actually see a website: a plain HTTP fetch with no JavaScript, the way GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and OAI-SearchBot fetch pages. Every finding quotes what the fetch returned, with a fix. Paid endpoints are paid per request over the x402 protocol in USDC on Base ($0.01 per check), with no account and no API key: a GET without payment returns 402 with the requirements in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header.

AISkills402 sells tested AI agent skill files (SKILL.md, Agent Skills format). An agent buys the FILE of a skill once, over the x402 protocol, in USDC on Base mainnet, for cents. No account and no API key. The agent keeps the file: re-downloads and new versions of a skill it owns are free. A few skills are also sold as separate pay-per-call APIs. Start at https://aiskills402.com/llms.txt and https://api.aiskills402.com/openapi.json.

AwakePix is an all-in-one AI image and video generator. Turn photos into videos with Seedance, Kling, Wan and MiniMax, or create images with GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana. Get one free video, then pay as you go, no subscription.

Mysocial connects AI assistants to permitted social content, research, ideas and Brand Studio context over Streamable HTTP/OAuth 2.1. Free basic tools; paid Content Memory and creator research. Monthly USD: Free $0; Creator Memory $49; Creator System $149; Authority Intelligence $349; Authority Studio $799; Agency from $1,999 (annual contract). Platform/plan limits apply. Proprietary hosted service; public plugin metadata is MIT. No social publishing or scheduling.

Public Codex usage-limit reset signals with timestamps and confidence levels. Read-only JSON, RSS and iCalendar feeds of platform-wide Codex reset announcements, plus a Telegram bot (2/day). Free, no key, no signup.

Aident Loadout connects Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT and other MCP clients to your apps and 400+ expert-built Skills through one setup. Connect accounts once and reuse them across agents; credentials stay in Aident Vault and every action is logged in Audit.

Hosted MCP for invoices, estimates, quotes, receipts, purchase orders and PDF export. Uses saved customers, items, payment records and unpaid balances. Streamable HTTP and OAuth; Codex verified. Records shared with web, iOS and Android under company permissions. Currently free; account document and storage limits apply. Email is disabled by default and each send needs confirmation. No card charging, transfers or refunds. Other clients need remote MCP and OAuth support.

Remote Streamable HTTP MCP for creating website projects, deploying supported GitHub repositories, and reading deployment status, build logs and usage. Shipvela account and OAuth S256 PKCE required. Hobby free: 3 projects and 20 publishes/month; paid plans available. Public beta Codex plugin and publishing skill; hosted runtime is private. Setup: https://shipvela.com/integrations/codex.

MCP tools for social drafts, AI content, carousels, video clips, scheduling and publishing. Hosted Streamable HTTP uses OAuth 2.1 and workspace consent. The MIT TypeScript CLI (@autoposting.ai/cli 0.4.0) offers stdio via ap mcp with AUTOPOSTING_API_KEY and Node >=20. Requires paid Autoposting access; publishing requires connected social accounts. Backend is proprietary, not self-hostable; render jobs are asynchronous.

Raphael AI is a free AI image generator for text-to-image and image editing. Use Raphael AI when you want an AI image generator without a login on the basic plan: text to image, an AI image editor, and common models. The free tier adds a watermark; paid plans are for commercial use.

Tale is an MIT-licensed workspace for teams and AI agents. Teams turn projects into tasks with context, owners, and acceptance criteria; configured agents work in persistent sandbox workspaces, and people review reports and deliverables together. It supports repeatable work through project knowledge, skills, and workflows. Free self-hosted software and paid managed deployment are available; agent runtime or model access may have separate costs.

Free AI image generator and AI video generator. Text to image, image to image, text to video, and image to video, plus an editor, photo effects, templates, background remover, and upscaler. Models include Seedream, Nano Banana, GPT Image, Kling, and Seedance.

Honer AI by XONER is a proprietary Android 7.0+ assistant with Russian and English interfaces, streaming chat, web search with source links, photo/document attachments, voice input and conversation history. The current APK download is free. AI responses and search need internet access; relevant prompts and attachments use cloud processing. Optional phone actions require user-enabled Android Accessibility.

Orkas is an open-source, local-first desktop AI workforce. A Commander turns goals into executable plans and coordinates specialist agents in parallel or sequence through one chat. The open-source core uses user-selected providers or compatible local model endpoints; optional hosted services may have separate costs.

Ready-to-ship Windows + Intel Mac desktop for rules-based trading (stocks, options, crypto, prediction markets). AI research beside statistical signals; automation follows your rules and limits. Full Access $399/year or $9.99 per coin/platform. Trading involves risk of loss. You can lose money. No profit guarantees.

DishVivid helps restaurants prepare food photos for menus, delivery listings and social posts. Adjust light, color and crop, compare with the original, and review optional AI-generated candidates before export. Check ingredients and portions before publishing. Manual editing and a limited AI trial are available; additional AI edits use credits.

LogoMovo is a logo creation studio for exploring brand directions, adjusting typography, colors and layout, and exporting SVG or PNG files. Subscription plans and extra AI credit packs are listed on the website. Review the final design before using it as a brand mark.

LookScene offers adults AI-generated portrait, hairstyle and outfit ideas from their own photos. The current free invitation preview has limited availability. Generated images are visual references, not exact virtual fitting or identity guarantees; review likeness and image details before use.
Music Video AI puts audio first, producing tempo-synced video drafts with mood styling, flexible editing workspaces, and multi-ratio 1080p exports.

NailMoodLab helps users explore AI nail designs and prepare manicure references. It offers a small free monthly AI allowance and lists paid plans, whose checkout availability should be checked on the site. Generated images are design ideas, not a guarantee of a salon result.

PackScena helps online sellers explore AI-generated product backgrounds and lifestyle scenes from original photos. Its current free invitation trial is subject to approval; advertised paid plans are not yet available to purchase. Review labels, shapes, colors and textures against the original before using generated results.
AILearnHub takes articles, ideas, and questions and organizes them into structured lessons for teaching or personal study.

The Face Report offers browser-based tools for exploring face shape, symmetry and facial proportions. Users can try free measurements and choose an optional paid report with additional analysis and personalized styling guidance. The site also includes color analysis and hairstyle tools. It is intended for informational and styling use, not medical diagnosis.

AI employees for small teams: delegate support investigations, sales research, content and recurring work with connected tools, permissions and approval rules. A remote Streamable HTTP MCP server connects compatible clients to the Yodu workspace through OAuth or bearer API keys. Proprietary hosted service; $499/month includes personal setup and up to five active AI employees. No free trial; model and third-party costs are separate.
Feeless x402 micropayments for AI agents — self-custodied XNO wallet, pay-per-call pricing, live A2A agent card on the Nano (XNO) feeless settlement rail.
Online AI image text editor that replaces existing words in finished PNG/JPG/WebP images and tries to match the original font, color, and background. Results vary by image.

CitePulse audits and monitors whether AI assistants — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude — cite your brand in their answers, and shows exactly which sources each engine pulls from. Free mini-audit; paid continuous monitoring. Built by GeoFlow Solutions.

Free appointment scheduling with shareable booking pages and an owner-authenticated REST API for finding availability, creating and verifying bookings, and cancellation. Currently in beta; Google calendar OAuth verification is ongoing.

Visible desktop browser for coding agents, with persistent named Chromium workspaces and local/loopback Streamable HTTP MCP access. People can pause MCP and take over. Windows, macOS and Linux. Includes Hronaut-owned wallet providers in preview for supervised dApp QA. Source-available; one 10-day trial from the first agent tool call, then $4/month or $24/year per named user, up to three active devices. Not a hosted browser service.

ModelRush is a hosted multimodal AI API platform for developers and product teams. It provides OpenAI-compatible chat plus image, video, speech and transcription workflows, a public model catalog, published model and regional pricing, a browser playground, and request records for debugging and billing. Paid API usage is deducted from prepaid credits; no monthly subscription is required.
Non-custodial payment drafts and pay links for BTC, USDC, USDT, and EURC. Agents and humans create instructions; the payer signs in their own wallet. Never holds keys or funds.

Hosted Model Context Protocol server for Magic Hour’s AI media platform, giving compatible AI clients authenticated access to image, video, and audio generation and editing tools over Streamable HTTP. Developers can also use Magic Hour’s REST API and SDKs.
Penroll is an AI hiring copilot for growing teams. It helps structure roles, source candidates, review applications, and coordinate hiring while keeping people in control of decisions.
Add a spend cap to your AI route. One consume() call before a model request. Default 20 units per user per day. Denied requests return HTTP 402. No Stripe, no dashboard, no plan builder.
Official 100Hires MCP: AI ATS & Recruitment Software for candidates, jobs, applications, interviews.
Blockchain intelligence for tracing funds, screening addresses, and investigating on-chain activity.
Scrape, crawl, map & search the web. Open-source, self-hostable Rust crawler & search for AI agents.
Intelligent product canvas: iterate on your product's design with your coding agent, synced to code.
Connects AI agents to live, verified financial data from 18,000+ institutions — ready to reason from
Find your job search blind spots with an AI coach

SourceSEO.ai is an AI-powered SEO automation platform that helps businesses improve search engine rankings, drive organic traffic, and increase visibility across Google and AI-powered search engines. It brings together website SEO audits, keyword research, AI-powered content generation, technical SEO analysis, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) in one platform. Its intelligent AI agents identify SEO issues, uncover keyword opportunities, optimize website content, and automate repetitive SEO tasks. SourceSEO.ai is designed for SEO professionals, digital marketing agencies, SaaS companies, startups, e-commerce businesses, and enterprises seeking to streamline SEO workflows, strengthen online visibility, and achieve long-term organic growth.

CheckAIVisibility is a free AI visibility checker. Enter your website and it asks AI models the buyer-style questions your customers ask, then shows whether your brand is mentioned, where it appears in the list, which competitors are named instead, and which third-party pages the answers cite, with one suggested action for each cited page.

The free check runs 5 questions on OpenAI with web search and adds on-site AI readiness checks: robots.txt rules for AI crawlers, llms.txt, JSON-LD, meta tags, server-rendered text and sitemap. It is limited to 3 free checks per day per network. No account is needed.

The full report is a one-time $9: 15 questions across OpenAI and Claude with web search plus Gemini from model knowledge, 2 runs each (90 answers), per-engine scores and one re-check after 30 days. No subscription.

Results come from the official APIs and can differ from the ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini apps. CheckAIVisibility is not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic or Google. It is a one-time audit, not ongoing monitoring.

SkillSoniq is an AI-powered hiring app that lets companies test-drive talent on real, paid work before committing to full-time payroll. Employers post jobs for free and get AI-matched candidates within seconds, then either hire onto payroll from day one or start a paid project and convert when ready. SkillSoniq runs background checks, handles onboarding paperwork and weekly timesheets, and sends one consolidated invoice. Pricing: free to post and hire; a payment-processing fee plus up to 20% commission on paid trial work; a buyout fee on payroll conversion. Web and iOS.

Hailbell is in-app support chat plus push notifications for iOS, Android and web apps.

Customers write from inside your app. An AI answers first from your docs and real prices, and you finish the reply from the dashboard, a Discord thread, Telegram or an AI agent over MCP. The customer gets a push when you answer.

Each conversation shows the customer's plan, purchases, device and country. Hailbell can show an offer card that opens your paywall, and ask for an App Store review right after a problem is solved.

Push campaigns go to iOS, Android and web in one send, with segments, each person's local time, quiet hours and daily caps.

Native Swift and Kotlin SDKs and a web widget. Unlimited apps and seats. From $29/month, free for 14 days, no card required.

PhotoCraft AI combines a free browser-based photo and PSD editor with optional AI tools. Edit layers, masks, text and adjustments manually, or ask an AI Agent to make supported changes to your open document. Generate images from prompts or references with a choice of AI models.

EasyRunCraft is a professional online office and creative suite built for people and AI agents. It brings 13 free browser editors together — WordCraft, GridCraft, DeckCraft, PdfCraft, PhotoCraft, LightCraft, VectorCraft, FigCraft, DesignCraft, FilmCraft, EffectCraft, SoundCraft and CADCraft — covering documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs, images, design, video, audio and 2D CAD.

Edit, save and export manually in the browser for free, with no account required. Sign in to use the built-in AI agent for in-editor changes, or connect your own agent (Codex, Claude Code and compatible MCP clients) so it can inspect and edit supported files and return results. One account and one shared credit balance work across all editors; new accounts receive starter credits. Manual editing stays free; AI and MCP processing use credits.

Glide is an AI agent that takes on the legwork of your job search: finding roles worth your time, researching each company and drafting applications written for the person who will read them. You approve everything. Currently invite-only - join the waitlist on the site.
OpenLegion is an AI agent platform for SaaS: secure agents call your functions, with a workspace per customer, approvals, spending caps and receipts.

Peeve is an AI customer support agent for SaaS teams. It answers questions from your docs, shows users where to click inside your product, takes actions like resetting a password or changing a plan, and hands off to your team when a human is needed. It works in your in-app widget and over email, and remembers each customer across conversations. Pricing is credit-based, with plans from $40/month and a 14-day free trial.

TinyCommand is an all-in-one no-code automation platform for founders, operators and business teams. It connects forms, visual workflows, data tables, AI agents and email tools so teams can collect information, manage data and automate follow-up in one place. Forms can look up data and branch while people fill them in, and workflows connect business apps. TinyCommand offers a free plan and paid plans. AI agent steps run on every plan; building custom agents starts on Professional. TinySEO and TinyAnswers are paid tools with a seven-day trial on Free.

REA.ai is an AI-powered real estate business phone system designed for agents, brokers, and real estate teams. It answers incoming property calls 24/7, responds to listing questions, captures buyer and renter leads, and helps schedule property showings.

With dedicated listing phone numbers and a built-in CRM, REA.ai helps agents organize inquiries, manage contacts, and follow up with potential clients.

Whether you're showing homes, meeting clients, or working after hours, REA.ai helps ensure valuable property inquiries don't go unanswered.

SkillsSafe is a free security scanner for AI agent skills. Paste content, enter a URL or upload a SKILL.md file, MCP config or system prompt, and it checks it against more than 20 detection rules, including credential theft, data exfiltration, reverse shells, prompt injection and hidden zero-width characters. Scanning runs client-side in the browser. No signup is needed.

Revnu is an AI agent that runs growth experiments for businesses. It finds potential customers, researches the right people, runs approved outreach, publishes search content and operates approved ad campaigns. Founders receive results and approval requests in Slack or iMessage. Pro is self-serve at $99 per month; Managed includes a dedicated growth engineer and is custom-priced.

Bicep Heart turns one clear photo of an adult into a 7-second, silent, vertical AI video in a bicep-heart pose. Sign in with Google, choose the classic or left-arm template, upload a photo you have permission to use, and download the clip to share. One credit per video; one-time packs start at $4.99, with no subscription. Failed generations return the credit.

We built TailGPT for businesses whose website is where enquiries start: clinics, coaching institutes, real estate firms, travel agencies. Paste one script tag and an AI agent appears on your site, no plugin needed. It reads only the pages you tick and any files you upload, so when someone asks "Are you open on Saturday?" the reply comes from your own page. If the answer is not there, it says so. Every fact it gives is checked against the source page. No AI is perfect, and we would rather you see that up front: test it in the dashboard and check which page each answer used. When a visitor wants to go further, it asks for a name and phone number and adds them to your leads list and Google Sheet. The dashboard also lists the questions your website doesn't answer, most asked first. It is not a helpdesk: it won't look up orders, book, refund or hand off to a person.

OmniaKey provides a unified AI API for developers building agents and applications. It offers OpenAI-compatible text endpoints and asynchronous image, video and music generation through one prepaid account. Developers can compare supported models and pricing, integrate with coding tools, and track usage in one dashboard.
OpenLinker connects, calls and coordinates AI agents. Order a service for a result, call agents directly, link MCP tools, or build multi-agent workflows. Hosted or open-source Core.

Genjutsu AI is an online video tool that recasts existing footage with your reference photos. Upload a source video or pick one from the community library, add the photos you want to use, and generate. A written prompt is optional. Motion Transfer keeps the original movement, timing, and camera while rebuilding the people and visuals from your photos. Object Swap changes one selected person, outfit, product, or object and keeps the rest of the shot as close to the source as possible. You can add one reference photo for each person, up to 10 photos per video.

FADEO turns viral TikTok trends into personalized videos. Choose a trend template, upload a clear photo (or short clip), and our AI recreates the same moves and timing with your face, pet, or friends in 9:16 — built for TikTok. Pricing starts from about $2.45 per trend video via monthly plans or credit packs; failed generations are refunded. There is no free plan or free trial.

ScorePredicts is an AI-powered football analytics platform combining machine learning, match statistics and live match data. It provides forecasts for match results, goals, both teams to score, corners and cards, alongside live scores, match events, fixtures, results and standings. Users can explore match statistics, lineups, referee profiles and statistics, and head-to-head records, while tracking historical forecast performance across more than 1,200 leagues.

TinyDesk Video turns one lead photo (plus up to three friends) into a 10-second vertical AI video inspired by a Tiny Desk–style band performance. Empty slots are filled with fictional AI performers. One-time credit packs from $7.99 — no subscription. Independent product, not affiliated with NPR.

RemoveBGNoise is a free AI-powered tool for removing background noise from audio and video online. Clean up podcasts, voice-overs, interviews, meetings, and videos without installing software, then download the result without a watermark. New users get 15 free minutes.

Image Combiner is an AI-powered online tool that blends and merges multiple photos into one cohesive image. It aligns perspectives and matches lighting and shadows automatically, so people, products and styles combine naturally without design skills. Free trial credits, no watermark.

AskMed is an AI medical assistant for healthcare professionals. If no trusted source supports an answer, AskMed says so instead of guessing. It is not a symptom checker. Available on iPhone, iPad, Android and the web in 7 languages.

Who it is for
AskMed is built for doctors, nurses, medical students, pharmacists and researchers. It is meant for people who already work with medical evidence and want to reach the right source faster. It is a tool for education and reference, not a substitute for clinical supervision or professional judgment.

How it works
You type a question in plain language, the same way you would ask a colleague. AskMed searches medical literature, clinical guidelines and drug labels, then writes a short, structured explanation. Each statement in the answer carries a citation, so you can open the original paper, guideline or label and read it yourself. Source filters let you narrow down where the answer comes from, and research tools help you go deeper on a topic. Because AI responses and citations can contain errors, AskMed is designed so that checking the source takes one tap. Always check each source's publication date and the latest official guidance, since information may be incomplete or outdated.

Why not a general chatbot?
General chatbots often give answers without real references, and searching PubMed by hand takes a long time. AskMed combines both: it answers in seconds and shows the evidence behind every claim. Guidelines and drug labels are built in, so there is no need to run separate searches. Guideline coverage is global, not limited to one country.

For every specialty
AskMed covers questions across internal medicine, family medicine, surgery, pediatrics, OB/GYN, psychiatry, emergency medicine, cardiology, neurology, oncology, anesthesia, radiology and dermatology.

Typical uses
Checking a guideline between patients, reviewing a drug interaction before counseling a patient, preparing for journal club, studying for medical exams alongside your usual materials, and looking up evidence during night shifts when there is no one else to ask.

Privacy and independence
Conversations are encrypted and never sold. AskMed shows no pharma advertising and is built independently, without pharma sponsorship.

Pricing and platforms
AskMed is a paid subscription, from $24.99/month. It runs on iOS, iPadOS, Android and the web, in 7 languages. If you subscribe in the app, you can cancel with one tap in your Apple subscription settings; on the website, use Manage subscription on your account page. BlockPoster.ai is a browser-based block poster maker that turns one image into a wall-sized poster printed across standard sheets on your home printer. Upload a photo or create artwork with AI, crop it, choose from five paper sizes and the page grid, preview the layout, and download a PDF with an assembly guide and predictable page order. Free PDFs need no account (up to 150 DPI, up to 5 sheets across, small watermark). Paid plans add unlimited HD, watermark-free PDFs up to 300 DPI, up to 10 sheets across, batch ZIP export and AI credits. Ordinary uploads are processed locally.

BobHairFashion helps people compare bob haircuts with AI face shape analysis, personalized style suggestions, and downloadable salon reports. It also offers free bob haircut planners that require no photo or account.

BodyScore is a Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) constitution self-test. Answer 60 questions in about 8–10 minutes and receive a free main result about your constitution type, for general wellness awareness. Optional extras: an AI report for $19.90 or a human-verified report for $29.90. It is a self-assessment tool, not a medical diagnosis or treatment.

Hire AI employees that work 24/7 on their own cloud computer. They research markets, find leads, track competitors and draft outreach, then ask before sending, posting or paying. Plans from $19/month. 30-minute trial of real work; a card is required.

A free, browser-based self-check for service businesses that accept appointments or quote requests. Walk through eight manual checks on a public route, record what you observe, then download your notes or build a prompt for an AI assistant you choose. This tool does not inspect or change websites, call an AI model, send your notes to iTeam, or predict bookings. No account, upload, or API key.

BoostGeo helps SEO, growth and digital marketing teams measure brand visibility in AI answers, assess website readiness, prioritize fixes and recheck changes. Its free public checker provides page-level SEO evidence and a separate AI-readiness assessment without an account or credit card; usage limits apply. Separate workspace plans support AI visibility tracking, site health, buyer-journey tests, prioritized fixes and verified facts. AI readiness does not measure independent AI recommendations or guarantee mentions, citations or rankings. Paid plans start at $29 per month, with a 10-day free trial and no credit card required.

BossCheck is a security scanner for indie game developers who build with AI coding tools. Vibe-coded games often ship with hard-coded Steam or Stripe keys, Firebase and Supabase databases anyone can edit, and multiplayer servers that trust whatever the client sends. BossCheck finds these issues and explains each one in plain English, with a paste-ready fix prompt for your AI tool. It's pre-launch: join the free waitlist, and read our free guides on Steam keys, Unity secrets and anti-cheat.

BPM Finder helps DJs, producers and creators estimate tempo and key from a reference track. Core BPM analysis runs locally in the browser without an account. Detailed results include confidence, half-time and double-time alternatives, meter, waveform and beat positions. Estimates can be wrong on complex rhythms or changing tempos, so check important results by ear. Optional signed-in Studio features turn reference attributes into an editable music brief and support AI-assisted creation using account credits.

BrickGPT turns a photo of a finished brick model into an AI-generated visual step-by-step instruction board plus a short assembly video. Independent product, not affiliated with any university research project.

AI British/UK accent TTS with 315 regionally labelled voices (RP, young British, Scottish, Welsh, Northern Irish). Preview speakers, paste a script and download natural UK English audio for videos, lessons and podcasts. Free daily credits.

Describe an idea in one sentence and Omi, the AI app builder from BuildItOmi, creates a working website or full-stack app with sign-in, a database and hosting. New accounts get 15 million free credits, no card. Then paid plans from $19/month.

Upload a bright front-facing photo of yourself or your pet. Burger Window AI builds the Window Peeper / burger-at-the-window scene: warm night window, mid-bite pause, stare at the camera, then curtain close. Vertical ~12s MP4 for social. No prompt writing required.
One portrait becomes the lead of the Burning Bridges cup-scene clip, about 29 seconds with the original soundtrack. Optional friend portraits. Freemium credits.

Busabase is an open-source database and workspace where people and AI agents share business records, documents, reusable skills and apps. Teams connect their own agents to the same context, with permissions, review when needed, and a history of changes. Available as Cloud, Personal Desktop and MIT-licensed self-hosting. Submitted for the Busabase team with AI assistance.

Also called the buss down filter — iced-out grillz, watch and chain from one photo. Smile with visible teeth. A hand in frame adds the watch. Generate Bust Down Filter · 1 credit · auto-refunded if it fails · 1 free preview per device per day (low-res, watermarked) Use only photos of adults who have given permission, for diamond teeth, watch and necklace effects. Upload one selfie with your teeth showing, pick a look (Grillz, Grillz + Watch or Full Iced Out) and press Generate Bust Down Filter. You get an iced-out photo and can download a 9:16 version for TikTok or Reels. The buss down filter is the same trend. Grillz, Grillz + Watch or Full Iced Out. 1 credit per photo. If a photo fails or is blocked after starting, the credit is returned automatically. Uploads blocked before generation use no credits; if a photo gets stuck, email support for a refund.

Butterneck lets product managers, designers and support teams ask for changes to an existing web app in plain English. An AI coding agent makes the change on a developer's connected computer, you check a live preview, and an engineer reviews and decides what ships.
BuzzyX is an X (Twitter) growth workspace for founders: write posts in your own voice with AI, schedule them and read real X analytics.

Bytekind is a set of simple, free AI tools for small nonprofit staff. Find grants that fit your mission, write donor thank-you letters, send volunteer reminders, try nonprofit AI prompts, check whether an app is safe to launch, and use a vibe-coder launch kit. Free to start with optional Plus upgrades. Built for busy operators, not IT teams.

Caddie puts tasks, notes, calendar and meeting notes in one Mac workspace. Hold fn to dictate in any app, plan your day with a coach in the notch, and share booking links. Run AI agents on your own Claude Code or Codex account, or connect them to your notes, tasks and calendar through https://usecaddie.app/mcp. Team workspaces are supported. Free while in beta.

CallJanice is a fully managed AI receptionist for home service contractors, including HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, and other trades.

It answers customer calls 24/7, qualifies leads using trade-specific questions, and books appointments directly into connected scheduling systems such as Jobber, ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, and Google Calendar.

CallJanice also supports multilingual conversations, urgent call transfers, automated follow-ups, and instant call summaries via WhatsApp or email. Its team handles setup, customization, and ongoing maintenance.

A 14-day free trial is available, followed by $149/month with 150 included call minutes and $1/minute for additional usage.
CallPad is an AI receptionist for salons, spas and med spas. It answers calls 24/7, handles questions and books clients into your calendar.

Calorie Calculator is a free health tracker that logs food from a photo, a sentence, or a barcode. It keeps calories, macros, weight, steps, water, and fasting together, works offline, and stores your log on your device.
Create AI videos and images with Capafy AI. Turn text or reference photos into visuals with leading models, clear credit pricing and a private creative library.

Capxule is the context marketplace: expert-curated capsules you take as guided AI journeys, then keep as companions. Free official-style practice tests include DMV permit (California first), CDL, US civics, FAA knowledge exams, and amateur radio, plus guided study for exams and life decisions. Web, iOS, Android, and MCP for your assistant. First answers on each journey are free; continue with a free account.

CareOps Maeumi is an AI counseling app for Korean- and English-speaking users. It combines self-assessments, voice or text conversations, and exercises such as thought records, with saved notes and practice between sessions. Conversations draw on established approaches including CBT and ACT. It is available on iPhone, Android and the web. Free sign-up, intake and initial self-checks are available; session offers and prices are shown in the app. It is not a substitute for professional diagnosis, medical treatment or emergency care.
Turn a photo into a playful caricature portrait with AI. Explore styles, create a career caricature, and personalize your avatar. First caricature free with no sign-up.

CastRemix remakes a short video using your own characters from a 2–30s reference clip plus a character photo. Uploads are private. A quote is shown before generation. It does not guarantee exact face replacement, unchanged backgrounds, or lip sync. Plans: Starter $9.9 USD/month with 500 credits, Creator $29.9 with 1,800 credits, Studio $99.9.

Turns two portrait photos into a ~15s 720p 9:16 kitchen coffee-fail comedy video. Assign coffee-maker and milk-pourer roles. One-time packs $9.90 (1) / $24.90 (3). No subscription. No free generation.

CharaGacha creates an original character from a short description, with a portrait, name, personality, and backstory. Users can choose an art style and export PNGs, then reuse characters for emotes, PNGTuber frames, chibi art, and VTuber sheets. Guests get one free creation daily; name and backstory generators are free.
Turn one photo of yourself into a brand-new AI-generated charme dance video. Consent-first, private by design, no editing skills needed.

Free online cross stitch chart generator — turn any photo or text into a stitchable chart. Free up to 50x50, no signup. Real DMC colours with CIEDE2000 matching, printable A4 PDF, AI pattern generator.

ChatGPT Images is an online AI image generation and editing tool based on OpenAI gpt-image-2: text-to-image, 4K enhancement, background removal, and batch resizing, with an inspiration gallery and multilingual UI.

Christmas AI is a browser-based holiday studio with eight tools for Christmas photos, printable cards, pet portraits, ugly sweaters, Santa hats, and personalized Santa videos. Upload a photo or choose a style, then download images or MP4 clips. New accounts get 10 free credits; one-time pay-as-you-go credit packs are available with no subscription.

Christmas AI Photo turns one selfie into a Christmas photo that still looks like you. Upload a clear, front-facing photo, pick one of 77 festive scenes — Santa suit in the snow or on the beach, ugly-sweater flash selfies, candy cane shoot, cozy pajamas, a holiday card and more — and download a picture sized for Instagram, Facebook or a card. No prompt writing. New accounts get one free watermarked preview with no card needed (sign in with Google). After that, one-time credit packs: 15 HD photos for $4.99, or 40 for $9.99. No subscription, credits never expire. Photos are private, selfies are deleted after 7 days and never used for training.

Christmas Dance (christmasdance.org) is an AI Christmas dance video generator: upload photos (JPG, PNG, or WebP, up to 10 MB each; one person per photo, clear face and good light), match each shot to the labeled dancer slot, pick a solo, duo, or group template with music, and download an MP4 with the selected soundtrack. Templates on the homepage include Matching Pajamas, Solo Christmas Groove, Bestie Christmas Dance, and The Christmas Crew; durations are 4–15 seconds (the featured packs are 12 seconds). Output is 480p for 1 credit or 720p for 2 credits, including solo and group dances, aimed at TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Credits are one-time packs with no subscription and do not expire: Stocking Filler $9.90 (2 credits), Christmas Party $24.90 (6 credits), The Whole Crew $59.90 (16 credits); mix resolutions from the same balance. Confirmed generation failures return the credits charged (not an automatic cash refund). Only use photos and audio you have permission to use. Directory listings: Free, support@christmasdance.org.

Christmas PFP Maker is a web tool at christmaspfp.org that turns an ordinary photo into a festive Christmas profile picture. Upload a portrait, pick a Christmas-themed look, and get an avatar for social apps and chat. A free path is available; paid options may apply for extra generations.

Chrome Extension Downloader helps developers and product researchers explore Chrome extensions. Download available CRX or ZIP packages, inspect source files and permissions, compare extensions, explore historical growth trends and research keywords. AI-generated review summaries highlight strengths, drawbacks and recurring issues in collected user feedback, with original reviews available for closer inspection. A Research Skill and API-key-based MCP access bring extension data into Codex, Claude Code and compatible AI clients. The service offers free and paid features.
CinePixel is an AI workspace for creating and editing images and videos. Limited starter credits are available after sign-in; ongoing use is paid.

Citelane is a beta AI visibility (GEO) audit tool for small SaaS teams and founders. Paste a page URL and pick a few buyer questions; Citelane asks major AI assistants through their official APIs and shows whether your brand is mentioned, whether your site is cited, and which competitors are cited instead. It also checks crawl and index basics such as noindex, canonical and robots.txt rules for AI crawlers, then drafts one fact-checked page edit from facts you confirm and verifies it once you publish. A limited free check needs no sign-in; paid plans add more audits. Results are API samples and no tool can guarantee citations.
Paste a reference list or claim; verify against 250M+ scholarly records across Crossref, OpenAlex, PubMed, arXiv, Semantic Scholar, and Retraction Watch.
CiteScope audits whether ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity can find, crawl and cite your product, with a report in 24 hours. $49 one-time audit, $19/mo monitoring.

Citevant helps businesses track and improve their visibility in AI search. It monitors answers from ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and Claude, tracks competitor mentions and identifies the articles those engines cite. Citevant discovers relevant publisher contacts and sends personalized outreach requesting contextual brand mentions. Teams can follow visibility, outreach replies and Domain Rating from one dashboard.

ClapClip brings photo and video face swaps to your Windows PC. Work locally, preview your changes as you go, and process files in batches instead of repeating the same steps. It supports NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPUs on Windows 10 and 11. Downloading and previewing are free; exports require an in-app purchase. Use media and likenesses you have permission to edit.

Clarpex is an online AI photo fixer for the photos people actually have: soft phone shots, low-resolution images, scanned family prints and black and white pictures.

Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP (up to 20 MB) and pick the tool for your problem: enhance photo quality, sharpen, unblur, remove glare from glasses and glass, unpixelate, upscale to 2K, 4K or 8K, convert to HD, restore old photos, colorize black and white photos, change the background, or make AI images look like real photos.

Every result opens in a before/after slider so you can compare it with your original before downloading, and the credit cost is shown before you start.

Everyone gets 10 free credits every day with no sign-up and no watermark. Paid plans start at $9.90 a month, and one-time credit packs never expire. Photos are only used to create your result, never to train AI, and are deleted after 24 hours without an account.

ClassGamify helps teachers create quizzes and matching activities, printable worksheets and student assignment links. AI-assisted activity drafting is one feature; teachers can also edit their own lesson content. Teachers can review scores and export results as CSV. A free plan is available. Teacher accounts are required to save activities, while students can open assignment links without creating accounts.

ClassPaws is a classroom workspace for teachers. Use AI to draft lesson plans and quizzes, recognize progress with points and virtual pets, and organize classroom groups and seating. Try the public practice classroom without adding a real student roster. The free plan supports one class with up to 60 students.
An unofficial Claude developer guide with current model docs, Claude Opus 5.5 migration notes, Claude Code tutorials, API workflows, and best practices.
CleanAudio removes noise, filler words, silence, stutters, and background music in your browser. The same tools also work from Claude or Cursor through a hosted MCP. Free to start.

ClearFrame removes watermarks, subtitles and logos from your own videos with frame-by-frame AI. MP4 and MOV up to 100MB. Your first video gets a free 5-second preview, no signup. Full processing runs on credits: Starter 10 credits $9, Pro 50 credits $39. Also includes a free Matcha Filter Remover and video Enhance upscaling.

ClearRemover is a browser-based AI photo cleanup tool. Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP image (up to 20 MB), brush over whatever you want gone - a photobomber, a date stamp, power lines, a trash can - and the AI fills the area with background that matches the rest of the picture. Only the brushed area changes, and you can compare before and after with a slider before downloading. A separate mode removes the background automatically and exports a transparent PNG for product shots, profile pictures, stickers and slides. It works on phones as well as desktop. You can start without an account: you get 2 free images a day, plus 2 more after signing in with Google, and downloads carry no watermark. Uploads are stored privately, deleted automatically within 48 hours, and never used to train AI models.

ClipNoter is an AI video note taker. Upload one MP4, MOV, or WebM file and get a timestamped transcript, summary, key points, and timed sections, with optional key frames. Export Markdown, ZIP+images, TXT, SRT, or VTT. Start free with weekly credits.
ClipWhim turns still photos into short AI videos. Upload an image, pick a motion style, and generate a shareable clip in minutes.

Clone is AI project management for small teams without a dedicated PM. Describe a rough goal and the AI assistant turns it into a structured project with tasks, plans sprints, organizes workflows and can analyze your files. Run the work on boards, timelines, calendar and reports, with templates and team collaboration, synced with Outlook, Microsoft Teams and Google Calendar. Free 10-day trial with no credit card, then Clone Pro at $9.99/month.

Clone Cut AI recreates the structure, pacing and shots of a viral video ad using your own product, logo, background and copy, while keeping existing people unchanged. Upload media you have rights to, describe the edit, review a plan and quote, and confirm before anything is generated, with delivery to your private account.

Closed on Sunday Maker turns one photo into a short AI choir video. You stay still and silent in the centre while the crowd sings. Silent clip; add TikTok trend sound when you post. No watermark. Independent fan tool.

Club Spotlight Couple AI makes the viral La Tormenta de Arena club spotlight video (te he perdido entre la gente) from 2 photos, for couples, friends or pets. Fan-made and not affiliated with the band Dorian. Also available in Spanish. Paid, from $9.90 per video.

Cluegent is a Windows and macOS desktop AI assistant for interview practice and permitted live meetings. It provides real-time answers, rolling conversation context, screenshot-based coding help, and responses tailored to your resume. The desktop overlay works alongside Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, coding editors, and documents without joining the call as a participant. A free trial is available, followed by paid hourly packs or monthly access.
CNIPA.AI assists patent practitioners in preparing editable drafts, searching patent documents and creating drawings for review.

Coffee Making AI turns two photos (people, pets or toys) into a 10 or 15 second vertical clip of the viral coffee making fail: the grounds miss the red mug, the milk floods the counter and nobody flinches. You get an MP4 with no watermark in a few minutes, with no app and no account needed for a single video.
AI comic book maker: free scripts (10/day), consistent characters, editable bubbles. Pay per panel. Export PNG/PDF/CBZ.

ComicStory AI turns a written story and one character photo into a print-ready comic book. Paste a script, upload one reference photo of the main character, and the tool lays out pages, draws every panel and places speech bubbles. Unlike other AI image tools that redraw the character each panel, it locks one reference across the whole project so the face, hair and outfit stay consistent from page one to the last page. Twelve art styles, editable layouts, print-ready PDF export and a shareable web reader. Fifty free credits on sign-up.

Comiora is an AI comic and webtoon generator that turns stories into editable storyboards and illustrated pages. Choose from manga, webtoon, American comic, and watercolor styles, then export comics or animated videos. New users receive 20 free starter credits, with paid credit packs available.

CooperBuild AI is construction software for general contractors. Teams estimate once, then carry that estimate into the project budget, trade bids, submittals, pay applications and CRM, so every job runs from one workspace on web, iOS and Android.
Recreate trending AI video templates with a single photo — same video, starring you, with sound.
Guides and tutorials for Crawl4AI, the open-source AI web crawler for Python — installation guides, crawling tutorials and data extraction examples.

Create Image is a browser-based workspace for turning a written idea, and optionally a reference image, into still images or short videos.

In the workspace you choose image or video, write a prompt, and, when the selected model supports it, upload a reference image you have permission to use. The site shows the currently available models and the settings for that model �ü such as aspect ratio or video length �ü before you submit. It also shows the credit cost for that generation.

Create Image currently sells monthly plans billed in credits: Starter at $9.99 for 100 credits, Creator at $19.99 for 300 credits, and Pro at $49.99 for 1,000 credits, as listed on the pricing page on 14 November 2026.

Creatune AI is a free AI music generator. You can turn lyrics or a text prompt into a full song, create AI music videos, add accompaniment, and remix. People can generate original music from text at https://creatune.ai without needing a studio.

CutoutFox helps creators, marketers, and online sellers remove image backgrounds, refine cutout edges, add color or image backdrops, and batch process up to 20 images. New users start with 30 free credits.

CV Objective helps job seekers prepare application materials for a specific role. Users can start with their work history or an existing resume, build and edit a targeted resume, and compare it with a job description. The review helps identify relevant experience and wording that may need a closer look. Users can also draft a matching cover letter in the same workspace. AI suggestions are editable. Applicants should check every proposed detail against their actual experience and decide what belongs in the final application. The tools are useful when applying to different roles and keeping each resume and cover letter relevant to the position.

productName: Damon Salvatore Church Edit AI Video Generator
description: Damon Salvatore Church Edit AI Video Generator recreates the church-entrance sequence (entrance, holy water, sign of the cross, smirk) from one photo. 10-second 9:16 MP4 with the reference audio. One-time packs from $6.99 — no subscription. Independent fan tool, not affiliated with The Vampire Diaries or Warner Bros.
DanceIV Studio (SeedanceIV) turns prompts and images into AI videos and creative remixes. Text-to-video, image-to-video, and remix workflows for creators and marketers. Freemium.
Data2Paper turns survey, questionnaire, experimental, and clinical datasets into previewable research papers, literature reviews, and peer-review reports.

Datrace connects AI assistants to Amazon marketplace data through 44 MCP tools covering 10 marketplaces. Sellers and analysts can research ASINs and categories, discover keywords, inspect organic and sponsored rankings and traffic, and compare competitors. It uses Streamable HTTP with OAuth. The Free Beta includes 20,000 monthly credits with a 7,000 weekly cap. Documentation: https://www.datrace.com/en/docs/get-started

productName: Day of the Dead for Pets
description: Upload one pet photo and get a 10-second vertical 9:16 720p memorial video in scenes like Marigold Bridge, Ofrenda, Gentle Guide and Candlelight. Also a guide to the pets' Day of the Dead (Oct 27): calendar, ofrenda altar, marigold path, Xoloitzcuintli, FAQ. One free preview still per day; videos from $9.99.
Decisions API playground and API for classifying and routing text.
Free AI tool that describes any image and generates alt text for accessibility, SEO and content creators.
Upload lead (and optional keys/sax) portraits; DeskConcert generates a ~15s 9:16 AI desk-concert video with original funk audio. Independent parody—not NPR. Browse free; ~2,250 credits per video.

DetectivePPC is a Google Ads audit and monitoring platform for PPC freelancers, agencies, and in-house marketers. Users connect a Standard or Manager (MCC) account with read-only Google OAuth. Each investigation covers 50+ dimensions across performance, keywords, ads, structure, tracking, bidding, targeting, and Performance Max. Audits typically finish in around 5 minutes and produce a health score, prioritized findings, and a white-label PDF. Every plan includes an AI Account Strategist with live chat, change detection, goal pacing, scheduled audits, a weekly recap, industry benchmarks, and a portfolio dashboard. Pricing: Freemium/paid plans from $39/mo (Basic $39, Pro $99, Business $199, Agency $499). 7-day trial · 1 free audit · Read-only access

An AI photo-to-dance video generator that works in your browser. Upload one or two photos of consenting adults, choose a scene, and get a short vertical video with template music. Party Bite is a 9-second solo entrance from one photo; Duo Dance is a 7-second two-person routine from one or two photos. Both deliver a 720p 9:16 MP4. Each video costs 10 credits. Packs are one-time, credits never expire, and confirmed failed jobs restore credits. Examples are free to watch. An independent creative tool. Consenting adults only; the tool does not support children or pets.
Free disclaimer generator with templates for websites, email, affiliate (FTC), medical, financial, legal, AI content, copyright and privacy. Copy or download, no signup.

Upload a PPTX or PDF, pick an AI presenter and voice, and get a narrated slide-by-slide video with lip-sync — up to 40 pages / about 80 minutes in one render. Freemium with a free 6-page trial. For training, education, onboarding, and sales enablement.
AI document translator for PDF, Word, PowerPoint & Excel. Translate into 100+ languages without losing the layout — tables, charts, images and styles stay put.

Dog Bartender AI Video Generator turns one clear photo of a dog, cat, or person into a 15-second vertical MP4 with the fixed $1 → $5 → $50 bartender sequence, built-in sound, and no watermark. One-time credit packs from $7.99 — no subscription. Independent product, not affiliated with the original trend creator.

DogPrompt turns an everyday dog photo into a polished AI portrait while preserving the dog’s face, coat colours, markings, ear shape and expression. Pet owners can also upload one photo of themselves and one of their dog to create a new image together. Templates cover Christmas, Thanksgiving, birthdays, weddings, memorials, studio portraits, royal portraits, watercolor, oil painting, sketches, cartoons and more. The first preview is free, credit packs are one-time purchases, and there is no subscription.

Dola AI Hub is a browser-based workspace for generating AI videos, images and audio. Compare models like Seedance, Kling and Wan side by side, see the credit cost of each run before you generate, and start with 10 free signup credits. Independent product, not affiliated with ByteDance or the official Dola app.

Free-to-start AI filmmaking platform for short dramas, films, music videos and commercials — script, characters, storyboard, scenes and timeline on one infinite canvas, with a built-in AI production Agent.

Drawing to Animation turns a photo of a paper drawing into an eight-second animated clip. Upload a crayon, pencil, marker or watercolor drawing without writing a prompt. The tool fits the drawing into a frame, with controls to adjust its position, zoom and rotation. AI adds movement while aiming to retain the original lines, textures and handmade character. The first animation is free after email verification, with paid packs available for more clips.

Generate short videos and images from prompts or references. Drizzle supports creative scenes, product ads, character visuals and social content, with guided product workflows and model-specific formats.

DubbingNow takes a clear one-speaker recording and produces a translated voice track you can preview in the browser. Timing is aligned to the original, and both video and audio uploads are accepted. It is free to start.

DubTab gives you three ways to run the same real-time dubbing stack. The Chrome and Edge extension follows tab audio on Windows, macOS, and Linux. The desktop app on Windows 11 and Mac can listen to the whole machine or a single app. The Android app (Android 10+) floats translated captions over the video and plays a dubbed voice in the app you already use. Either way you get AI dubbing, bilingual or translated-only subtitles, and roughly 0.5-second latency across 50+ languages. Designed for courses, streams, and videos without uploading files. Freemium pricing with shared hours across all clients.
Duct Tape AI is an online AI image generator for prompt-based creation, editing, and text rendering. Credit-based downloads, built for teams that need images fast.
Upload a selfie and preview hairstyles, bangs, hair colors, and facial hair on your own face before you commit. Free to try in the browser. Built for face-shape matching, not deepfakes.
EasyRemoveBG is a free AI background remover for JPG, PNG and WebP: refine edges, pick a new background, and download a transparent PNG. No account needed for single images.

EditBright is a free AI image editor that runs in the browser — no sign up and no login. Upload a photo, edit or generate, and download. Image-to-image, background remover, and photo enhancer are available on day one. Default tools stay free; optional paid models are there for more power.

Editpad is a free collection of online tools for everyday text, file and image tasks. It includes a paraphrasing tool, an AI text summarizer, a JSON formatter, a JPG-to-PDF converter and other practical utilities that work in the browser without installing software. It is useful for students, writers, developers and office users who need quick, reliable helpers for editing, formatting and converting content.

Effect Farm is a photo-to-video AI with AI video effects, from an AI dance generator to meme scenes. Turn one photo into a trending video. It costs $4.99 a video, with packs from $2.40 a video. You see your price first, and no sign-up is needed.

Emosapien helps mental health practitioners prepare for sessions, draft clinical notes, share between-session work, and keep client context together. Practitioners review and edit AI-assisted drafts and make clinical decisions. A free plan is available.

Create custom Twitch emotes from text or reference images. Emote Studio generates static PNGs or animated GIFs, with chat-size previews and downloads at 112, 56 and 28 pixels. New accounts receive 30 credits for one static emote; further credits are one-time purchases.
English shadowing app: turn any YouTube video, audio, or text into sentence-by-sentence speaking practice with instant AI pronunciation feedback. Free to try.
Describe your work in plain text; AI generates invoices, contracts, proposals, estimates, receipts and more. Built for freelancers who need clean client documents fast.

EPUB Translator is an online AI tool for translating DRM-free EPUB ebooks. It is designed to preserve book structure, images and supported formatting, with translated and bilingual EPUB output. Readers can try an opening-chapter preview before paying for a full-book translation. It serves readers, language learners and authors working with books they have the right to translate. AI translations should be reviewed before use or publication.

productName: Erase Traffic Signs using Ediroo AI
description: Urban photos often include traffic signs, parked scooters, or warning cones. Ediroo lets photographers highlight these fixtures and replace them with matching street textures. Check sidewalk paving and facades after each generation.

EssayAce is a free first-pass grader for college application essays. Paste a draft and get an instant score out of 100 across five dimensions: personal voice, story & specificity, reflection & insight, prompt relevance, and structure & writing. Feedback is sentence-level and includes revision priorities, so students can see where a draft is generic, where reflection is thin, and what to fix first. It supports Common App personal statements, UC Personal Insight Questions, supplementals, Why This College/Major essays, and scholarship and transfer essays. Students get 1 free full grade per day with no signup required. Essays are not stored or used for training. Use it as a structured self-check before counselor or peer review — not as a substitute for the student's own voice or a human reader.
Estate Render helps architects and interior designers visualize interior, exterior and furniture ideas with AI.

EstimateReview is an AI-assisted second-pass review of property insurance claim estimates and supplements for contractors and independent adjusters. EverAlice AI is a product launch studio for Etsy, digital, and print-on-demand sellers. Free live preview, no signup or card required.

Excel for Accountants Practice is a free interactive learn-by-doing site: lessons 1–4 are fully open (no signup). Exemplary AI turns one long video into a week of content. From the same transcript it writes summaries, blog posts, show notes, chapters and social captions, and you can publish or schedule the clips to your social accounts from one workspace. Built for podcasters, YouTubers, course creators and marketing teams. Free plan with one-time credits; paid plans from $29 a month.

AI rap video generator: turn one or two photos into a rap performance. Add lyrics or an occasion, pick a stage, and create in your browser. Maker VastPace. China. 2026. Paid (credit-based).

EzHomeo is AI-assisted homeopathy software for practitioners, clinics and colleges.
