New accounts start with 10 consultation credits and no card. EzHomeo is made by Omnoryx Technologies Private Limited in Assam, India.
AI image editor: upload a photo, describe the change, and edit it with GPT Image, Nano Banana or Seedream models. Private images, clear credit costs. Freemium. Maker VastPace. China. 2026.
Upload a photo of your room and create an AI-generated picture and camera-style clip of Santa visiting. The photo is free; the full AI video pack is $7.99 one-time.

FableClip is an AI faceless video series generator. Design a character once, keep it consistent across episodes, generate scripts, voiceover and visuals, and auto-publish to TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Reels. Plans from $19/month.

Free browser face analysis for a photo-geometry score, face shape, symmetry and related tools. Landmark detection runs on-device; original photos are not uploaded to our servers. Free core tools need no sign-up.

Face Analysis AI is an English-language web tool for AI face analysis. Face shape detection and a photo attractiveness test / rating are free. A personalized improvement report is paid ($17.49). The score is feedback on a photo, not a medical or professional diagnosis.
Face Report helps you understand your face and find your style with a free private on-device scan.
FacePika is an on-device AI face-swap app for Android. Swap faces in your own photos and videos or use templates, then preview, save, and share. Finished swaps have no watermark. Freemium.

FaceRater’s free score stays free: face score out of 10, PSL rating and tier, golden-ratio match, face shape and best feature, with no sign-up. The full report is a one-time $9.99 purchase and is not a subscription. You see the free score before you buy. The report is an instant digital product, so all sales are final. If you are charged twice, or you pay and the report is not delivered because of a technical problem on their side, they will deliver the report or refund that payment. The official site is https://facerater.beauty/.

FaceRef is a browser-based 3D head reference tool for artists and AI portrait workflows. You orbit a 3D head to set an exact yaw and pitch, move the key light to study portrait shadow design, then export structure-first output — Loomis construction sketches, Asaro plane studies, and depth or edge maps ready for ControlNet in Stable Diffusion, FLUX, and ComfyUI. The 3D viewport and three low-resolution exports per day are free in the browser; Pro adds 1024px exports and higher daily limits.
FaceSearch is a reverse face search engine that finds where a person's face appears online. Upload one photo and it scans social, dating, and public web sources for matches.

Facetry gives you an AI beauty score from a single selfie in the browser. The score itself is free. If you want the longer write-up, the full report is $9.99 once, not a subscription. It is aimed at people who want a straightforward face read rather than filters, editing, or a makeup preview.

Entertainment-only celebrity look-alike finder and face geometry analysis for adults using their own selfie. Shows top celebrity matches, face shape, symmetry and golden-ratio measurements; this analysis runs locally in the browser. Optional AI portraits and PDF reports upload the photo only after separate consent and use one-time credits, no subscription. Not medical advice.

Fame OS is the software that underpins everything Fame does: the operating system behind Fame's done-for-you B2B podcast, LinkedIn creator and AI-search/AEO services. It covers guest & topic planning, production workflows, repurposing episodes into LinkedIn/social content, and pipeline & visibility tracking. Offered as part of Fame's services.
Famed shows local businesses how often ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI, Perplexity, Claude and Grok recommend them, and fixes what holds them back. Free AI check.

Fancy Cafe AI is a browser tool for making your own version of the TikTok trend "POV: your first time in a fancy cafe". Upload one photo of yourself, a friend or a pet, optionally add a second photo for the guest, and get a 10 to 15 second vertical MP4 with sound, up to 720p and no watermark, usually within minutes. Made for TikTok, Reels and Shorts creators; no prompts, no app and no account needed for one video. Videos start at $3.99.

Fancy Cafe POV is an independent AI video generator for people recreating the viral fancy cafe POV meme. Pick two photos, sign in with an email code, and generate an 8-second vertical clip. One-time video packs start at $5.99, with no subscription. The site also offers a free in-browser photo planner and meme guide.
FantasyDailies is a sports analytics platform featuring AI parlays, player props, game simulations, LiveTV, and GameZone.

FBVerse Bot is a Windows desktop application for automating Facebook Marketplace work. It is built for sellers who manage many listings and need to post, renew and manage ads across multiple Facebook profiles, cities and product niches without repeating the same manual steps every day.

The software posts new Marketplace listings, renews expired ads, and schedules posts across multiple profiles. Each profile runs in an isolated browser profile, and posting follows human-like pacing, so activity is spread out rather than fired in rapid bursts. It supports the listing formats of the major Marketplace categories, including vehicles, property and rentals, home and repair services, and general e-commerce items.

Recent modules include an instant hotkey for listing renewal, an AI auto-reply for Facebook Messenger that answers common buyer questions and captures contact details, a specialized vehicle lister with VIN decoding, mileage, transmission, body style and title status fields, and image preparation tools for listing photos. 

FBVerse Bot is a desktop program, not a browser extension or a web dashboard: it runs on a Windows machine and drives the browser locally. Setup involves adding your Facebook profiles, preparing your listing content and images, and choosing the categories and locations you want to post to. From there, the posting and renewal routines run automatically according to the schedule you configure.

The software is commercial. A free demo is available on request via WhatsApp so you can see the workflow before buying, and continued use requires a paid licence. It is aimed at professional resellers, dealers, agencies and lead-generation teams who treat Marketplace as a serious sales channel and need their listings to stay live and current across many accounts at once. Listing content can be prepared once and reused, so a whole inventory stays current with a fraction of the daily effort that fully manual posting would take.

Female Malfoy is an AI photo-to-portrait tool. You upload a clear photo, pick one of 36 fantasy scene templates, and it generates a stylized portrait with platinum hair, dark academy robes and castle-style settings. You can choose the image model and resolution (1K to 4K), add your own prompt or a second character, and turn the result into a short video. New users can try one image a day for free. It is an independent fan-art tool and is not affiliated with Harry Potter or Warner Bros.
Upload one photo and get an AI holiday portrait of you, your family, your partner or your pet. Christmas is live with 20 looks. First photo free, no watermark. After that, each photo costs 1 credit.

FideNubi is a free directory and interactive comparison resource for renting a Mac in the cloud. Compare Mac mini configurations, data center locations and rental prices across Europe, North America and Asia. Use maps and filters to narrow the options by provider, chip, memory, storage and monthly price. Practical guides explain cloud Macs for iOS development, CI/CD, creative work and AI workloads. Prices and specifications are checked against providers' public pages.

productName: fifty cents per extra photo text edit after the free first one

Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB, type the words as they appear and what they should say instead, and the editor rewrites those words in a similar font, color, size and position. Remove mode erases listed words and fills the background. Translate mode rewrites lines into one of 20 languages and keeps brand names, logos, numbers and prices unchanged. The first edit is free; after that each edit costs $0.50. A $5 top-up covers ten edits. There is no subscription.

AI flashcard maker for students. Paste notes or enter a topic to get question-and-answer study cards, then review with quizzes and spaced repetition. Text and topic decks start without sign-up; PDF and Word import needs a free account. Free use has limits; Pro is a paid plan.
FlashEdit is a browser studio that turns prompts and references into videos, images, music, and voiceovers, then lets you enhance and export them for social use.

FlexFiles runs in the browser: convert PDFs to and from Word, Excel, PowerPoint and images; compress, merge, split and repair PDFs; edit text and pages in a full PDF editor; send documents for e-signature; and ask the AI assistant to summarize documents or answer questions about them. Built for freelancers, virtual assistants, small businesses and students. Free plan; paid plans from $4.99/month. Affiliate program: 30% recurring for 12 months.

FlipFlow is an online flipbook maker that turns PDFs, PowerPoint files, Word documents, and images into interactive digital publications. Create flipbooks and AI-generated storybooks, customize their appearance, and share them with a link or embed them on your website. It's useful for product catalogs, presentations, educational materials, and digital storytelling.

Flits is an iOS and Android app that extracts dates, times and event details from screenshots, photos and pasted text. Users can review and save events to their calendars. It includes ten free AI scans each month.

Floor Plan AI from PlanArt is a browser-based floor plan ai tool for trying out home layouts before you meet an architect. Type a room list or pick a template with floors and total area, add plot dimensions in meters or feet, or upload an existing plan or a hand sketch as a reference. It returns layout concepts as Technical 2D drawings, furnished 2.5D overhead views or 3D isometric renders at up to 4K. You can mark one area of a plan and ask for a change in plain words, convert a 2D plan into 3D, or draw walls, doors and furniture yourself in the Maker and export PNG, SVG, JSON or DXF. Free accounts get 100 credits a day and paid credit packs start at $9.90. Results are concept images, so have the dimensions checked by a professional.
FloorDrafter is an AI floor plan generator for homeowners, landlords and designers: upload a sketch or old plan and get a 2D or 3D plan that keeps your layout.

Flow AI Video turns a text prompt or reference image into a short video. Pick a model such as Kling, Veo or Seedance, set format and duration, and preview the credit cost before you generate. Freemium, credits-based.
Flow Music turns a mood, your lyrics, or a text prompt into songs with vocals or instrumentals. Remix, extend, split stems, download and share your tracks.
Use FLUX.2 Pro online to generate and edit AI images. Type a prompt, add up to 8 reference images, and create 4MP visuals with clear text. Start with free credits.
Turn a prompt or a photo into a 5–20 second FLUX 3 Max video with synced sound at 720p or 1080p. Set a start and end frame, then run the next take. Free starter credits; paid plans from $19.90/mo.
Make short AI video from a prompt or a photo. Text to video and image to video in one free FLUX 3 AI video generator — no card to start.

Flying Broom AI (flyingbroomai.com) is an AI video generator that turns one photo into a short broomstick-flight video. Users add a clear photo of one person or pet (JPG, PNG, or WebP, up to 10 MB), choose a prepared scene, and review its duration and 10-credit cost before creating. Homepage examples include Street flight (6 seconds, 720p), Beside the car (6 seconds, 720p), and Police stop (11 seconds, 720p). After creation, the video can be watched and downloaded as an MP4. Official pricing is one-time USD credit packs; credits never expire, and failed renders are refunded in credits. Sign-in is required to use credits and create a video.

FontKind AI restores your handwriting from an uploaded photo into a reusable personal TTF font, and can also create fonts from text descriptions or style images. Preview with your own words and download for cards, letters, and design work.

You interview customers at scale by letting an AI interviewer run consistent voice conversations in parallel, instead of scheduling and moderating each call yourself. You still set the questions, invite people you can already reach, and read the transcripts and themes; more volume is not a substitute for checking the quotes. Frank (https://www.hifrank.ai) is a voice-first product that runs AI-moderated voice interviews with your own customers. Frank does not recruit participants. It can run hundreds of interviews overnight, supports 50+ interview languages, and is SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliant. MCP is included on every plan, including Free, and works with ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Instinct and Muse (tested), plus other MCP clients that support remote servers with OAuth. Video, WhatsApp and chat interviews are Coming soon.

Free AI Rap Video turns uploaded photos into short AI-generated rap videos using ready-made templates. Choose a scene and add your photos to create personalized clips for social sharing. A limited free trial is available, with paid options for further use.
Browser-based AI audio separator for creators, karaoke, and remixes. Isolate vocals or instrumentals without installing software.

FreeUpscaler upscales video and images in the browser using your own GPU. The local tier needs no account and adds no watermark. Optional cloud AI processes uploaded files for credits, with per-run pricing and no subscription.

FreeVideo AI is a focused MiniMax H3 video workspace with text-to-video, photo animation and first-and-last-frame generation. Eligible new Google accounts receive 60 one-time welcome credits valid for 30 days. Text tasks cost 6 credits; image-based tasks cost 8. Public output is silent standard-resolution MP4 footage. Submitted by the product team.
Freemium photo-to-video AI. Upload JPG/PNG/WebP, describe motion, generate with Kling, Veo, Seedance, MiniMax, Wan. Free try; paid from ~$24.92/mo yearly.

Submitted by an owner-authorized AI assistant. FujinAI provides free Shopify image tools for resizing, compressing, cropping and converting product photos. Merchants can prepare product imagery through an independent website. This is not an official Shopify product, verified Shopify app, or proven store integration. Source and tool example: https://www.fujindeai.com/tools/resize-image . No revenue or conversion improvement is promised.

FullCastBook turns a manuscript into an AI audiobook with a full cast. Upload an EPUB, PDF, DOCX, TXT or Markdown file, or paste a chapter, and it finds the chapters, works out who is speaking in each line and gives every character a distinct voice alongside an AI narrator. Swap any voice from a library of standard and premium voices (built on Gemini and ElevenLabs voice models), and keep the same cast across a series.

Direct any line in plain English by adding a note in brackets, such as [whisper, like sharing a secret], and drop sound tags like [laugh], [sigh] or [breathe] exactly where they belong. Regenerate a single line without redoing the chapter, then export the finished audiobook as one M4B with chapter markers, MP3 files or a ZIP. It also works for two-voice podcasts and dialogue, audio drama, bedtime stories and book trailers.

Signing up is free with no card, but there are no free credits: audio is paid with credits from a plan (from $9.90 a month) or a one-time top-up, and cost depends on how much text is voiced. You can publish exported files wherever you hold the rights to the text; store policies on AI narration vary, and Audible and ACX do not currently accept AI-narrated audiobooks. English works best today, scanned page images are not supported, and voice cloning is not available yet.

For indie and self-published authors, web novel and LitRPG writers, fiction podcasters and audio drama makers, YouTube storytellers, and teachers making classroom read-alouds.

Marketing and AI call answering for home service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing and other trades). AI agents answer calls, texts and forms, triage emergencies, block spam and book real jobs into your software, plus manage Google Business Profile, Local Services Ads and paid search. Paid per booked job, month-to-month, and you own everything.

Turn your selfies into 40 professional AI headshots across 10 different looks. Fylvy is a one-time $39 purchase, with delivery usually within about an hour. If you're not happy with the result, you can request one redo within the redo window. From MRSLM Group LLC.

Fyslide is a desktop app for making TikTok photo slideshows and Instagram carousels. Choose a design, give it a topic and use your own AI to write the slide text. Edit text, images, stickers and shapes, then export PNG or JPG slides with captions. Batch-create slideshows, plan posts by account, and publish to TikTok or send drafts to your TikTok inbox. A local MCP server lets tools such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor create, edit and export slideshows. Bring your own AI login or API key, or run Ollama locally. Available for macOS and Windows Beta. One-time lifetime license for one computer, no subscription. A license is required; no trial mode. Instagram publishing is not yet available.

Gagle is a cast of AI characters you can talk to. Every profile is fiction: a name, a job, a city in a real timezone, moods and a routine that keeps going without you, plus a memory of your conversations. Every character is clearly marked as AI. There are no real people on Gagle. It is for company and conversation, not for meeting anyone. Free to download, with an optional Gagle Premium purchase.
An AI Gantt workspace for real schedules: bring your Excel or Project file, describe what changed, review the impact, approve, and export.

GenBulin47AI is an independent browser-based image-to-video studio. Upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP portrait of one consenting adult, up to 10 MB, and use one credit to generate a roughly 14-second vertical MP4. A licensed reference scene guides movement and framing; no prompt writing is needed. Users can track, preview, and download the result. Generated details may differ from the source. Credits are sold in one-time packs. The service is not affiliated with the Bulin 47 creator or brand.

Reusable templates and a visual canvas connect creative generation steps, so teams can adapt workflows for new products and creative variations. A free plan includes limited credits, with paid memberships available.

Pick a scene from a large AI template library, add your cast photos, and get one complete video from $7.99 — no account required. Browse 150+ curated AI video templates, add one clear photo per labeled role, choose 480p ($7.99) or 720p ($11.99), and receive a private MP4 after manual preparation. No account, no subscription, no prompt. Independent site I made / operate.
GenVid is an AI video and image generator for ads and products. Create clips from text or photos with multi-model Studio, ad templates, daily free credits, and credit packs or subscriptions.

GeoEcho is an AI search monitoring platform that records answers from enabled AI platforms so teams can review brand mentions, recommendations, competitor share of voice, sentiment, and cited domains. Enter a domain, set monitoring prompts and competitors, and GeoEcho submits those prompts to the platforms available on your plan. Results appear in one dashboard, with mention rate, recommendation ranking, and citation sources for investigation and content planning. A distinctive coverage area is global and China engines in the same product: ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini alongside DeepSeek, Kimi, and Doubao. Illustrated platforms on the marketing site are not a promise of availability; current access depends on plan entitlements and channel status. Pricing is public. Plans start at $29/month for Starter, with Pro at $99 and Team at $299 (lower monthly equivalents when billed yearly). You can register and configure a project first, but collection requires a paid plan and credits. GeoEcho is owned and operated by Tapilot LLC. Support: support@geoecho.ai.

Recreates the viral Hotel Lobby AI trend (orange booth, two performers) from two clear photos. 15s vertical 9:16 MP4, silent so users add TikTok’s COLORS original sound. Independent tool, not affiliated with the artists.

AI Rap Video is an online AI rap video generator that turns photos of two people or pets into a rap performance with music and synced vocals. Start with a photo together or two individual portraits. Upload your own background or choose a preset scene. Let AI create a surprise rap, share an idea to guide the performance, or add your own lyrics. Choose your video length, quality, and aspect ratio, then generate and preview the result. Finished videos are saved to My Videos and can be downloaded as watermark-free MP4 files to share. Create personalized birthday raps, videos with friends, and short clips for social media without writing a detailed prompt. AI Rap Video uses one-time credit packs starting at $8.99 with no subscription. Credit usage depends on video length and quality, and the total is shown before generation.

GetRender is an all-in-one AI design studio for architecture, interiors, and landscapes. Turn sketches, photos, and floor plans into visual concepts for design exploration and client presentations.

Explore architectural exteriors, compare facade materials, redesign rooms, stage empty interiors, and develop garden or courtyard ideas. Floor plan tools help visualize layouts, while rendering tools let you explore different materials, lighting, and styles.

Designed for architects, interior designers, landscape designers, and design studios, GetRender brings these tasks into one workspace. Upload a reference, describe your design direction, and generate images to support your next design decision.

Gfxlift is a free in-browser Roblox thumbnail maker: upload a game screenshot, add text, characters and borders, then export a 1920×1080 or 1280×720 PNG. No watermark, no account. Not AI; not affiliated with Roblox.

AI ghost mannequin and flat lay product photography for clothing sellers, transforming existing mannequin, hanger, flat-lay or worn garment photos into clean catalog images. Also create colors and on-model shots; download 2048 px results.

Giant Cat AI turns one clear cat photo into a 10-second video of your cat towering over a New York street. No prompt is required: upload a photo, preview it, and use the preset scene. Download the finished clip as a 720p vertical MP4 (9:16). The public sample was generated with Kling 4.0. You can watch it for free; generating a video uses one-time credit packs starting at $9.90, with no subscription.

Giggy provides a hosted speech-to-text API for developers, with batch, fast and streaming transcription. The STT resource is https://giggy.ai/speech-to-text and documentation is at https://giggy.ai/docs/speech-api. Giggy also ranks 3rd out of 21 models benchmarked by word error rate in Verli’s independent STT benchmark: https://verli.app/blog/speech-to-text-accuracy-benchmark. That result covers Giggy Fast on LibriSpeech test-clean.
Upload one photo and see the girl version of yourself in about 20 seconds. Get 4 free credits (two images) when you log in with Google.

Git Homed — a daily mirror of GitHub Trending. See the most starred and most active repositories every day, with weekly and monthly rankings across Images, Videos, Audio and AI Skills. Free, no sign-up, no sponsored placements.
Glam Up AI is an English AI styling tool. Upload a selfie plus a celebrity photo to recreate that hair, makeup, and outfit, with a preview and tutorials.
GLearn is a free AI exam prep app for BECE and WASSCE students. Practise, get written answers marked instantly and study with AI coaches Kevin and Anna.
GlowUp AI is an English AI styling tool. Upload a photo to get hairstyle, makeup, and outfit recommendations, with a preview.

Turn text or a reference image into looping AI GIFs, stickers, reactions and pixel art. Watermark-free output. No subscription. Verified accounts can claim one-time free credits, with additional credits available as one-time purchases.

GramClaw helps sales teams, recruiters, and agencies run personalized Telegram campaigns and follow-ups from their own accounts. Replies arrive in a shared CRM inbox with tags and a pipeline. Its Telegram MCP connects Claude and Cursor for AI-assisted inbox work and campaigns with confirmation before sending.

GrammarCheck.site is a free writing workspace with 69+ grammar, spelling and readability tools — built for students, researchers, marketers and anyone who writes in English. Paste a draft into the editor and get instant feedback: grammar agreement, punctuation, homophones, clichés, tone, sentence variety and readability, all checked against 25 named writing dimensions. Six readability formulas, an AI sentence rewriter with 6 modes, Hemingway-style highlighting, citation generator (APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard), AI writing detector, tone checker and thesaurus. Everything runs client-side in the browser: text is never uploaded or stored. No signup, no account, no paywall — 100% free forever.

Upload photos in any order; the AI sorts by age, morphs each pair, adds music, and delivers continuous plus pause-on-photo versions. Formats 9:16, 1:1, 16:9. For birthdays, weddings, Mother's Day, memorials, glow-ups. Pay once per video from $4.90. GrowingUpVideo turns 2–32 real photos of the same person, couple, or pet at different ages into a smooth age-morph MP4 with music in 5–10 minutes—not an age filter.

GTA5Goodbye is an AI video maker for creators who want a cinematic GTA 5 goodbye style scene from a selfie or portrait. It guides visual treatment, camera motion, and share ready export for social clips, farewell tributes, and playful meme storytelling.

GuanPalm is a browser-based AI palm reading tool for entertainment. Upload a palm photo to generate a magazine-style reading card based on traditional palmistry, with options in Traditional Chinese, Japanese and English. A free reading is available, with a paid deeper analysis option.

H3 Flex (h3flex.com) is an independent AI film studio powered by the Pika API (Pika H3 Flex). Create 5–15 second videos with synchronized sound via Text to Video, Image to Video, image-based Reference to Video, and Draft to Video upscaling. Explore at native 480p or 768p, then finish favourite takes at 1080p, 2K, or 4K. Credit cost shows before generate; text/image modes use 2 credits/sec at 480p and 4 at 768p, with reference mode at 3× that rate. One-time credit packs work without a required subscription; confirmed failed tasks restore generation credits (not an automatic cash refund). JPEG/PNG/WebP inputs up to 10 MB; download from My Films. Directory listings: Free, support@h3flex.com.

H3 Image is a web app for MiniMax H3 Image, the open-weight image model MiniMax released in November 2026. Write a prompt or upload photos to edit, get 2K or 4K pictures in about 20 seconds, and turn any picture into a MiniMax H3 video. New accounts get free credits to try it.

Turn a prompt or still into a 5–15 second MiniMax H3 Max video. Choose 480P or 768P, review the result, and create your next take on H3 Max. Write one line or drop a single still frame. MiniMax H3 Max hands back a 5–15 second clip with the audio already synced — watch it, change a word, run the next take.
HackAIGC is an uncensored AI image generator and AI chat platform for adult creators—generate NSFW images and chat without mainstream filters.

Haira is an AI interview and recruitment platform for hiring teams. It creates job descriptions, ranks resumes against a role, screens candidates through AI phone calls, and runs AI video interviews. Recruiters can review scores and transcripts, compare candidates, send offers and maintain talent pools.
HairFit previews hairstyles on your photo with Safe Match, Fresh Change, and Bold Upgrade directions, plus a Cut Card for your stylist. First Safe Match preview is free after sign-in.

Handwriting AI is a browser-based text-to-handwriting converter and printable worksheet maker. Choose from 100+ built-in handwriting fonts, multiple paper styles, formulas, images, and shapes, then export watermark-free JPEG, ZIP, or PDF.
Harry AI Dev is the personal site of Harry, an OpsDev engineer and indie full-stack builder sharing AI product experiments, shipping notes, and tools built after hours.

Turn one front-facing photo into a roughly 10-second shaking-head AI reaction meme video. Upload JPG, PNG, or WebP up to 10 MB. Download a silent MP4 or a version with original clip audio. No CapCut or prompt needed. Independent AI parody — not affiliated with TikTok or CapCut. One-time purchase per video; choose quality before pay.
Free headcanon generator for fanfic writers, OC makers and roleplayers: character and ship headcanons, OC maker, incorrect quotes and backstories.
